title: Sawing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Wood
description: Set up, operate, or tend wood sawing machines. May operate computer numerically controlled (CNC) equipment. Includes lead sawyers.

tasks.text: Inspect and measure workpieces to mark for cuts and to verify the accuracy of cuts, using rulers, squares, or caliper rules.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Adjust saw blades, using wrenches and rulers, or by turning handwheels or pressing pedals, levers, or panel buttons.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control setting for cutting

dwas.name: Set equipment controls to meet cutting specifications.

tasks.text: Mount and bolt sawing blades or attachments to machine shafts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting tools requires hands-on setup

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Set up, operate, or tend saws or machines that cut or trim wood to specified dimensions, such as circular saws, band saws, multiple-blade sawing machines, scroll saws, ripsaws, or crozer machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control setting for cutting

dwas.name: Set equipment controls to meet cutting specifications.

tasks.text: Inspect stock for imperfections or to estimate grades or qualities of stock or workpieces.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Lumber inspection requires physical handling

dwas.name: Inspect lumber or raw woodstock.

tasks.text: Monitor sawing machines, adjusting speed and tension and clearing jams to ensure proper operation.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Sensor/vision monitoring possible, but physical verification and accountability remain human

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure proper functioning.
Clear equipment jams.

tasks.text: Sharpen blades, or replace defective or worn blades or bands, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal and fitting of worn components

dwas.name: Replace worn equipment components.
Sharpen cutting or grinding tools.

tasks.text: Guide workpieces against saws, saw over workpieces by hand, or operate automatic feeding devices to guide cuts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cutting equipment operation is manual and judgment-based

dwas.name: Maneuver workpieces in equipment during production.
Operate cutting equipment.

tasks.text: Clear machine jams, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically clearing jams in machinery

dwas.name: Clear equipment jams.

tasks.text: Lubricate or clean machines, using wrenches, grease guns, or solvents.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual lubrication of production equipment

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.
Lubricate production equipment.

tasks.text: Adjust bolts, clamps, stops, guides, or table angles or heights, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual fixture adjustment

dwas.name: Set equipment guides, stops, spacers, or other fixtures.

tasks.text: Examine logs or lumber to plan the best cuts.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Lumber inspection requires physical handling

dwas.name: Inspect lumber or raw woodstock.

tasks.text: Trim lumber to straighten rough edges or remove defects, using circular saws.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual trimming of workpieces

dwas.name: Trim excess material from workpieces.

tasks.text: Count, sort, or stack finished workpieces.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Counting physical products needs presence or sensors

dwas.name: Count finished products or workpieces.
Sort materials or products for processing, storing, shipping, or grading.
Stack finished items for further processing or shipment.

tasks.text: Position and clamp stock on tables, conveyors, or carriages, using hoists, guides, stops, dogs, wedges, or wrenches.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting workpieces is physical loading

dwas.name: Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.
Position raw materials on processing or production equipment.

tasks.text: Measure and mark stock for cuts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking reference points requires hands-on measurement

dwas.name: Measure materials to mark reference points, cutting lines, or other indicators.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Operate panelboards of saw or conveyor systems to move stock through processes or to cut stock to specified dimensions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Woodworking equipment needs dexterity and material feel

dwas.name: Operate woodworking equipment.

tasks.text: Examine blueprints, drawings, work orders, or patterns to determine equipment set-up or selection details, procedures to be used, or dimensions of final products.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.
Study blueprints or other instructions to determine equipment setup requirements.
Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Select saw blades, types or grades of stock, or cutting procedures to be used, according to work orders or supervisors' instructions.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Input material selection from specs; human approves

dwas.name: Select production input materials.
Select production equipment according to product specifications.

tasks.text: Cut grooves, bevels, or miters, saw curved or irregular designs, and sever or shape metals, according to specifications or work orders.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on industrial material cutting

dwas.name: Shape metal workpieces with hammers or other small hand tools.
Cut industrial materials in preparation for fabrication or processing.

tasks.text: Unclamp and remove finished workpieces from tables.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically extracting parts from production equipment

dwas.name: Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.

tasks.text: Dispose of waste material after completing work assignments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical disposal of trash and waste

dwas.name: Dispose of trash or waste materials.
